//: Every number below is a placeholder. Copy this to data/property.json and fill it in with the real ones. data/ is gitignored, which is where the real numbers live: this repository is public and a work address, a budget and a child's school run are not facts to publish.
label: example, not real numbers

geography.//: Where the commute goes. Fill origin_lat and origin_lon in or no drive is measured, since a drive time from nowhere is not a number.

thresholds.//water: One buffer per kind of water, because they are not the same risk. NHD maps every wet-weather ditch in these counties and nearly every rural parcel has one inside 300 ft, so treating all three alike flags most of the county without finding any flood risk.
thresholds.//aadt_radius: A traffic count only speaks for the frontage if the counted segment is next to the house. NCDOT counts the highway and not the lane beside it.

money.//income: Household income and monthly debts, which the USDA cap and every debt to income answer need. Leave them at zero and the loans are still priced, and the eligibility lines say what could not be checked rather than assuming.
money.//tax: Combined county plus municipal rate per $100 of assessed value. A county:city key wins over the bare county one, since a house inside town limits pays both. These move at every revaluation.
money.//revalued: The year each county's last general reappraisal took effect. An assessed value is as of this year and the estimate carries it forward on the FHFA index from there, so a wrong year is a whole cycle of drift.
money.//usda: USDA's guaranteed programme income cap per county for a household of one to four, which rises 8% for five to eight. USDA publishes it as a PDF map and it moves every year, so a county with no entry here says it could not check rather than guessing.

//destinations: Everywhere other than work a drive is measured to, every time. Geocode each one and paste the coordinate, since a wrong one here is a wrong number on every report.
